description.value: Caffe W is a Vancouver café that has been operating since 1995, with its original home on West Broadway and a newer downtown outpost on Robson Street. The café serves a broad menu of espresso drinks, iced coffees, smoothies, brunch plates, and a distinctive signature item — the Dubai Chocolate Strawberry Cup with pistachio and kenaf — found nowhere else. Situated on a busy pedestrian strip in the West End, it offers both indoor and outdoor seating.
